title: Loblolly & Logit · Six-Edition Reading Feature Re-Issue Audit
scope: All 30 readings across six editions, 2026-09-25 through 2026-10-30
policy: Evidence-led inclusion; no fixed quota; only distinct authored and qualified features. A third requires explicit rationale.
methodology: Retained all five authored primary exhibits per edition; recognized independent publication figures and diagrams as Economic Figures; added five source-bounded, explicitly non-estimated companion features where a second lens clarifies a separate economic question. Existing scholarship, links and archival dates are preserved.
limitations: No new primary-source verification, econometric estimation or live browser QA was performed. Re-issue claims concern repository publication artifacts; GitHub Pages deployment is not independently confirmed.
